_comment: ESPN lineupSlotId map. Verified live on 2026-08-11 against league 1248158344 via
lineupSlotCounts, cross-checked against the slot labels rendered on the team page.
Unlike espn_selectors.json's DOM selectors, these values are confirmed.
IMPORTANT: the lineup_updates payload carries `slot` as a display string ('RB1', 'WR2',
'FLEX'). Ordinal suffixes are NOT distinct ESPN slots -- 'RB1' and 'RB2' are both
lineupSlotId 2, which simply has 2 open positions. Strip the suffix before mapping.
slot_counts is this league's specific roster shape and is re-read from the API at runtime;
the copy here is a documented reference/fallback, not the source of truth.
